evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/nfc/NFCAccessController.ts:300-324 validateAccess() — time-restriction check gates on `restriction.days.includes(currentDay)` where currentDay = now.getDay() at tap time (L301), THEN applies the midnight-crossing branch `endMinutes < startMinutes -> currentMinutes >= startMinutes || currentMinutes <= endMinutes` (L319-320)

Bug: for a window defined on day D spanning midnight (e.g. days:[1]=Mon, 23:00->01:00), the post-midnight portion falls on day D+1 (Tue). At Tue 00:30 currentDay=2 is NOT in days:[1] so L311 returns false and access is DENIED even though the Monday window should still be open

Mirror bug: at Mon 00:30 currentDay=1 IS in days:[1] and currentMinutes(30) <= endMinutes(60) so access is GRANTED — but that 00:30 slot is the tail of Sunday-night's window, not Monday's; Monday's own window only starts at 23:00

Reachable in production: public handleTap(accessPointId, name) (L163) -> validateAccess (L188) runs on every physical NFC door tap; manifests whenever an access point is configured with a time restriction whose endTime < startTime

Fix: when endMinutes < startMinutes, the post-midnight half must be matched against (currentDay-1+7)%7 ∈ days, not currentDay; i.e. evaluate the two halves of a crossing window against their respective calendar days
signals.title: mobile-rn NFCAccessController: midnight-crossing access-point time restriction checks the tap-day against restriction.days, so a window like Mon 23:00–01:00 wrongly denies Tue 00:00–01:00 and spuriously grants Mon 00:00–01:00

evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/nfc/NFCAccessController.ts (478 lines) — grep for 'NFCAccessController'/'AccessController' across *.test.ts/*.test.tsx returns ZERO hits; the file has no corresponding test anywhere in the repo

The class is the access-grant decision engine: validateAccess() (L249) enforces credential status, validUntil expiry, access-point membership, and time-restriction windows — a security-critical allow/deny gate for unlocking physical doors

By contrast its sibling frontend/apps/mobile/src/nfc/NFCCredentialManager.ts has NFCCredentialManager.test.ts (401 lines), so the coverage gap is specific to the authorization logic, not the NFC module as a whole
The midnight-crossing day bug (sister finding code-review-mobile-rn-nfc-timerestrict-midnight-day) is exactly the kind of boundary case a validateAccess unit test suite would catch
Fix: add NFCAccessController.test.ts covering denial reasons (suspended/revoked/expired), validUntil boundary, unknown access point, and time-restriction windows including a midnight-crossing case
